name: Procedural Cirrus Cloud Rendering
definition: A procedural technique for rendering cirrus clouds using layered fractal Brownian motion (fbm) noise on a 2D plane projected from the view ray, modulated by wind direction and time to create strands, hooks, and fibres.
summary: Procedural Cirrus Cloud Rendering generates high-altitude ice-crystal clouds using layered fractal noise to model fibrous structures, differing from volumetric methods by computing density analytically per ray.
